answer: A licensed karst spring steward holds one spring per applicant for 120 days. The spring gets a metered outlet and a crystal sample jar sealed at intake, and the steward logs flow and jar clarity weekly while a neighbor signs the tally. A ranger wanders the trail twice to match the log against the meter and the jar. Forged readings forfeit a 150 token deposit and bar the steward 180 days. Faking 10,000 springs freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars in licenses. A spring is like a well with one bucket. Everyone knows whose rope is on it, and a second rope gets cut the same day.
